title: Moving Day
blurb: Today you're moving your mum into a new ground-floor flat — she can't manage the stairs any more, and it all has to be done before dark. With the van running late, a removal man ramping up his price, and a box of your dad's things gone missing, you have one short afternoon to get her home honestly — and to decide who you let carry the load with you.

identity.name: Home by Dark
identity.mood: The last day in the old place and the first in the new; boxes, bare rooms, and a short autumn afternoon to get your mum home before dark.

cover.alt: A small removal van at the kerb at dusk, its back open and boxes on the wet pavement, with a warm-lit doorway and a figure carrying a box toward it.

line.en: You're moving your mum into a new place today, and the light is going. Get her home before dark — the honest way, with whoever will carry it with you.
line.fr: Aujourd'hui, tu installes ta mère dans un nouveau logement, et le jour baisse. Ramène-la chez elle avant la nuit — honnêtement, avec ceux qui voudront bien porter avec toi.
line.es: Hoy trasladas a tu madre a un piso nuevo, y la luz se va. Llévala a casa antes de que anochezca, de forma honrada, con quien quiera cargar contigo.
line.it: Oggi trasferisci tua madre in una casa nuova, e la luce se ne va. Portala a casa prima del buio, in modo onesto, con chi vorrà portare il peso con te.
line.de: Heute ziehst du deine Mutter in eine neue Wohnung, und das Licht schwindet. Bring sie vor der Dunkelheit heim — ehrlich, mit allen, die mit dir tragen wollen.
line.pt: Hoje mudas a tua mãe para uma casa nova, e a luz está a ir-se. Leva-a a casa antes de escurecer, de forma honesta, com quem quiser carregar contigo.
line.ru: Сегодня ты перевозишь маму в новую квартиру, и свет уходит. Успей привезти её домой до темноты — честно, с теми, кто готов нести это вместе с тобой.
line.zh: 今天你要把妈妈搬进新家，而天色正在暗下来。赶在天黑前把她安顿好——用正当的法子，和愿意陪你一起扛的人。
line.ar: اليوم تنقل أمك إلى بيت جديد، والضوء يخبو. أوصلها إلى البيت قبل حلول الظلام — بطريقة نزيهة، مع كل من يريد أن يحمل الحمل معك.

hero.sub: A story where you are the hero — and every choice turns you to a new page. Written for people learning English, at your level, with meaning in your language whenever you need it.
